title: Single men: tell us about your dating experiences
text:
If you’re open to talking to us about being a single man you can get in touch by filling in the form below. Photograph: BK/Alamy
Single men: tell us about your dating experiences
The Guardian is looking for single men of all ages to talk honestly about the experience of being unattached
The Guardian is looking for single men of all ages to talk honestly about the experience of being unattached. Whether you are 16 or 100, we want to hear the unvarnished truth about what it’s like to live as a single man today.
Are you trying to find love? Or are you happy living life as a bachelor? Do you find the experience of modern dating – with all its red flags and height requirements – to be a minefield? Or are you attracting more attention than ever before?
If you’re open to talking to us about being a single man you can get in touch by filling in the form below.
Share your experience
You can share your response using this form.
Please share your story if you are 18 or over, anonymously if you wish. For more information please see our terms of service and privacy policy.
Tell us here
Your responses, which can be anonymous, are secure as the form is encrypted and only the Guardian has access to your contributions. We will only use the data you provide us for the purpose of the feature and we will delete any personal data when we no longer require it for this purpose. For alternative ways to get in touch securely please see our tips guide.
